images.filename: Vicky Bs Dance Company Tulsa OK 2024-02-29 15-24-31 1.jpg
images.caption: After the 1921 Tulsa race massacre, the residents rebuilt the area, in some places using rubble from destroyed buildings. This is the only remaining structure from the initial rebuilding, it was the Dr. A.F. Bryand Building. 108 North Greenwood Avenue, Tulsa, Oklahoma 74120.
images.alt: After the 1921 Tulsa race massacre, the residents rebuilt the area, in some places using rubble from destroyed buildings. This is the only remaining structure from the initial rebuilding, it was the Dr. A.F. Bryand Building. 108 North Greenwood Avenue, Tulsa, Oklahoma 74120.

images.filename: Dr A F Bryand Building sidewalk marker Tulsa OK 2024-02-29 15-25-20 1.jpg
images.caption: A marker in the concrete sidewalk indicating that the building that was once here was the Dr. A.F. Bryand building. The building was destroyed in 1921 during the Tulsa Massacre and was rebuilt. 108 North Greenwood Avenue, Tulsa, Oklahoma 74120.
images.alt: A marker in the concrete sidewalk indicating that the building that was once here was the Dr. A.F. Bryand building. The building was destroyed in 1921 during the Tulsa Massacre and was rebuilt. 108 North Greenwood Avenue, Tulsa, Oklahoma 74120.

images.filename: 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre historical marker OK 2024-02-29 15-19-45.jpg
images.caption: A historical marker about the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre telling how a white mob attacked the black neighborhood of Greenwood in Tulsa Oklahoma.  This resulted in the destruction of 26 city blocks and the death of at least 26 Black Tulsans.
images.alt: A historical marker about the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre telling how a white mob attacked the black neighborhood of Greenwood in Tulsa Oklahoma.  This resulted in the destruction of 26 city blocks and the death of at least 26 Black Tulsans.
